title: COX CM Speedrun in 27 Minutes
summary: Gnomonkey does a solo Chambers of Xeric Challenge Mode speedrun attempt on stream and finishes with a new personal best of 27:04, just short of the world record. The commentary is mostly live reaction, with a post-raid room-by-room review.

outline.text: Intro and early commentary, previous attempt result
Early raid rooms: Ice Demon with dragon warhammer, vanguards, thieving
Mid-raid progression: pace check at 12:40 down to floor 3
Olm: hammer specs, brewing and a streak of zero hits
Post-raid review of each room and PB update

claims.text: The Chambers of Xeric Challenge Mode solo world record is 26:38, held by rot salad, per the video description.
Gnomonkey's 27:04 run was a new personal best in solo Challenge Mode; he reads out the change as 2751 to 2704.2 and says he is still ranked sixth.
Gnomonkey says that without the six zero hits in a row on lances in the middle of Olm and a bit less trolling, the run would likely have been a world record Olm at the very least.
Gnomonkey's pace at the time of reaching floor 3 was 12:40, which he considered not great; he says low twelves are nice and sub twelves are very fast.

Gnomonkey reviewed the raid backwards after finishing: Olm, Vasa and Guardians were disgusting (very good), Mystics pretty good, Muttadile kind of bad, Vespula, thieving and Tekton average, and Vanguards and Shamans bad.
Gnomonkey kills the Ice Demon in the Chambers of Xeric Challenge Mode speedrun with an Inquisitor's armour set and a dragon warhammer.
Gnomonkey kept health high and brewed heavily during Olm, saying not to chance anything while he had loads of brew.
Gnomonkey hit six zeros in a row on the lance phase of Olm during this run, which he called possibly one in a hundred thousand odds and the cause of losing four hits of time.
Gnomonkey says he needed to brew every single tick near the end of Olm to survive the final phase.
Gnomonkey calls the final Olm kill free once the damage landed, the freest it has ever been.
Gnomonkey streams on Twitch full time, per his own comment in the chat during the run.
Gnomonkey notes his Chambers of Xeric Challenge Mode time at the end of the stream was 27:04.2, and he says it would literally have been sub twenty-seven without the trolling.
